jobs.description:
**Location:** Eindhoven (Strijp-T) | **Hours:** 40 hours per week | **Employment type:** Direct employment

*We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join the Avular Team!*

At Avular, we believe mobile robotics will help make the world a better place, so our products and services accelerate the creation of new mobile robotic applications that shape a brighter future for all. Our goal is to make robots accessible globally and ensure they add value worldwide in the future. Our robots, both on the ground and in the air, are used across industries, always with our purpose in mind: from agriculture to cleaning and from construction to hospitality.

**YOUR MISSION**

Design and develop lightweight mechanical systems that deliver the required functionality, robustness, cost, and performance. Apply sound construction principles, strength calculations, tolerance stack-up analysis, mechanical systems dynamics, FEM simulation, and knowledge of material properties to substantiate design decisions.

* Translate system and stakeholder needs into measurable requirements for mass, strength and stiffness, robustness, cost, manufacturability and technical risk.
* Develop competing concepts, evaluate them against those criteria, then recommend and defend the preferred solution to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Back up designs with hand calculations, FEM simulation, tolerance stack-up analysis, dynamics and vibration analysis, and material selection.
* Work across the mechanical, electrical, control and manufacturing interfaces, and adapt your design when the best system-level trade-off sits outside the mechanical domain.
* Produce manufacturing-ready documentation (drawings with GD&T, defined tolerances, assembly instructions) so lightweight parts are built and assembled reliably.
* Build and test prototypes, and use the results to refine the design until it is verified.

* **WHAT YOU BRING**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 4+ years of professional experience designing, calculating and testing mechanical systems, including FEM.
* Advanced 3D CAD in Siemens NX, SolidWorks or CATIA, covering large assemblies, interface definition and tolerance specification.
* Fluent in spoken and written English.

**Nice to have**

* Lightweight structures experience from drones, aerospace, automotive or high-tech equipment.
* Experience with composites (e.g. CFRP) and/or design for low-to-mid-volume manufacturing (CNC, sheet metal, injection moulding, additive).
* Siemens NX specifically.
* Vibration analysis on structures carrying motors or rotors.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE**

At **Avular**, work meets play in the best possible way. We’re shaping the future of robotics, and we want you along for the ride.

Here’s what’s waiting for you:

* **Grow & Shine:** Bring your vision and grow your career in a fast-paced, high-tech environment

* **We’ve Got You Covered:** Salary based on experience level, A non-contributory pension scheme and travel cost reimbursement mean less stress and more focus on what you love

* **Share in Success:** As part of our participation plan, you’ll benefit directly from the company’s growth

* **Play Hard:** Game nights, Friday drinks, epic team events, and celebrations make our office more than just a workspace

* **Recharge Your Way:** Enjoy 30 paid vacation days (plus national holidays) to unwind, explore, or simply relax

* **Fuel for Greatness:** Savour the best coffee, fresh fruit, and snacks to power your day

* **Innovation Central:** Work at our beautiful office in **Strijp-T, Eindhoven**, a buzzing hub of forward-thinking companies and cutting-edge ideas

**WHO WE ARE**

At **Avular**, we’re on a mission to revolutionise robotics:
  
**“With gorgeous tech, we accelerate the creation of mobile robotic applications that shape a brighter future for all.”**
  
From our home base in Eindhoven, we design the tech behind autonomous robots, crafting drones and driving robots from scratch.
  
*Are you our new colleague?*
  
  
Adding a motivation letter to your application would also be a big plus.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer (€4.000 – €6.500)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Settels Savenije is evolving. Next to customer-driven engineering and research projects, we are increasingly focused on developing own technology and IP within the changing playing field of the semiconductor industry for the next few years and beyond. The ambition is high, the technologies developed will transform the semicon industry.

This requires a different kind of mechanical engineer.

Not someone who primarily specifies the mechanical design of a part or module based on given requirements, but someone who steps into the unknown multidisciplinary world of physics/mechanics/software/electronics and experiments, and reflects back on the requirements by drafting design concepts for parts and modules, and make that step to a final design once all consequences are understood by the multidisciplinary team members, while constantly aligning on demands with respect to lead time, manufacturability, costs and the right quality level.

Settels Savenije is a group of companies where high-end technology is combined with a passion for people. Besides the strategy to develop own IP, we work for our OEM customer base for which we invent, design, industrialize, manufacture, assemble and test high-tech products, modules, tools and equipment — and we train high-tech professionals, for ourselves and for our clients. Our motto: when a problem seems unsolvable, that's when it gets interesting.

**Job description**

From our base in Eindhoven, you take technical ownership of the mechanical design of parts and submodules within advanced high-tech systems for the semiconductor industry. You will join the mechanics group where fundamental understanding is persued to find the right design approach that enables the strategic project goals. You are the technical responsible for your design, making sure the requirements can be met proven by experimental results or calculations, in strong harmony with the software, electronics and physics (optics, cleanliness, …) disciplines. while keeping the design coherent, manufacturable and on schedule. The output of your work consists of a reviewed and released design (CAD models, drawings, bill of materials), calculations (strength, stiffness, dynamics, thermal, tolerances) and often experimental results (acceptance test, testing for concept evaluation, fit test based on 3d printed part mock up).

You are the point of contact for the lead engineer and architect in the project, from concept to industrialization. You work in the Settels Savenije way: we take ownership of program success, work in close cooperation with our clients' stakeholders and contribute as an independent development partner. Mechanics, electronics, software and physics sit under one roof, so multidisciplinary collaboration is part of your daily work — and where you make the difference.

**Your role**

* Act as the technical point of contact for the lead engineer and architect on the mechanical design of your parts and submodules.
* Guard the quality, manufacturability, functionality and lead time of the mechanical design.
* Perform and verify the complex structural calculations needed to underpin design choices.
* Align the mechanical discipline with electrical and software engineers and safeguard the technical coherence of the total system.
* Work within our quality systems and the V-model, including the associated documentation.
* Contribute actively to innovative solutions for complex high-tech challenges, using modern CAD systems (Creo, Siemens NX, SolidWorks or Inventor).

**What you bring**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, complemented by relevant training in engineering.
* 6 to 10 years of relevant work experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in a high-tech environment.
* Extensive experience in designing fine-mechanical constructions, preferably in high-vacuum environments.
* Strong knowledge of construction principles, mechanical design and tolerance analyses, and fluency with Creo or Siemens NX.
* The ability to approach technical issues integrally and connect disciplines — mechanics, electronics and software.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Knowledge of or experience with the manufacturing industry.
* A proactive attitude, analytical ability and an eye for detail.
* Good command of Dutch and English, spoken and written.

**What we offer**

* A salary between €4.000 and €6.500 gross per month, based on experience and a 40-hour workweek.
* 30 vacation days per year.
* A pension scheme with two-thirds of the premium paid by the employer.
* Travel and home-working allowance.
* Challenging projects for leading high-tech customers in the semiconductor industry.
* Short lines, real technical responsibility and room to grow.
* At STTLS, you work close to the technology, close to the team and close to the result. If you like solving difficult technical challenges and seeing your work become part of real high-tech systems, this is a strong opportunity to make an impact.

Interested? Apply now or contact Toon Lamers (Grouplead mechanics) at toon.sttls@recruitee-inbox.com.

jobs.title: Mechanical & CAM Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
**Manufacturing team · On site in Groningen · Full time**

**The role**

Arc makes jewellery-like precision hardware, a unity of art and function, machined from specialised aluminium alloys and titanium grades. That approach has made Arc one of the fastest growing companies in the Netherlands (Deloitte Technology Fast 50, rank 16).

Quality is non-negotiable, in the materials, in the process and in the machines and tools behind them. We are building a greenfield factory in Groningen and bringing production back from China to the EU. We need a hands-on machining lead who connects rapid prototyping today with mass production tomorrow.

You run our on site 5-axis machining cell from day one: cutting tools, fixturing, CAM programming and milling. Your mission is simple: **one prototype a day**.

**What you are accountable for**

* **One prototype a day:** fresh CAD from Product Design turned into a physical part, overnight where possible. Rapid iteration is the heart of product development
* **The machining cell:** tooling, workholding, CAM and machine upkeep under your control, with procedures written down so the work can be repeated
* **The scale-up business case:** real cycle times, tool life, unit cost and overhead, turned into a clear technical and financial case for growing one cell into an automated multi-machine CNC fleet, together with our automation and robotics team
* **Process specifications for mass production:** more than 100 people and even more machines at our production partner overseas make everything Arc sells today. Your specifications decide what they do and how. They learn from you, and you learn from them

**What you will do**

* **Own machining end-to-end,** from CAM to the finished part
* **Co-develop with Product Design** on every CAD iteration, and hand parts over to our surface finishing engineer in a state ready for polishing and coating
* **Build your own workshop:** a multi-ton 5-axis CNC is already there, and you decide what comes next
* **Learn from the best:** outreach to and visits with machine builders such as Hermle, DMG MORI, Kern, Chiron and SW
* **Work with our machine builder** on the equipment that follows

**Practical terms**

* **Location:** on site in Groningen. You live in the Netherlands or are ready to relocate
* **Team:** Manufacturing, working daily with Product Design, Surface Finishing, and Automation and Robotics
* **Contract:** full time

**How we hire**

* **Apply** with your CV and three short questions. It takes about 15 minutes.
* **Screening email:** five written questions about your career, your strengths and your last managers.
* **Practical exercise** at home, about 90 minutes. AI tools are allowed, as long as you understand every part of your answer, can derive it yourself, and stand behind it as your own best work.
* **Career interview** with the hiring manager, 70 minutes. You start by walking us through your exercise, then we go through your career job by job.
* **Culture interview and references** with former managers, only with your consent. Then an offer. A live case study may come before this step.

You hear back from us at every step, usually within two working days.

**What you bring**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience programming and operating professional 3-axis and 5-axis CNC milling centres
* End-to-end shop-floor ownership: specifying and buying cutting tools, designing workholding, writing high quality 5-axis CAM programs, and getting parts done
* A strong command of GD&T, cutting dynamics, and cosmetic, burr-free finishes
* A detailed understanding of how an industrial CNC machine works inside
* A BSc or MSc in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent, or a proven hands-on track record in machining instead
* A builder mindset: you enjoy hitting daily prototype targets today while thinking rigorously about unit economics and scale tomorrow
* Fluent English

**Useful, but not essential**

* Designing pneumatic or zero-point fixtures for robotic machine tending and lights-out runs
* Building your own machinery, automation and production systems
* Cosmetic machining standards ahead of polishing and surface coating
* Precision consumer hardware, such as watchmaking or luxury manufacturing
* Mass production: OEE, yield optimisation and cost tracking
* Dutch

We hire on trajectory more than on years. If your scope has grown fast and you can show results, apply even if you do not tick every box.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Eindhoven (Strijp-T) | **Hours:** 40 hours per week | **Employment type:** Direct employment

*We’re looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join the Avular Team!*

  

At Avular, we believe mobile robotics will help make the world a better place, so our products and services accelerate the creation of new mobile robotic applications that shape a brighter future for all. Our goal is to make robots accessible globally and ensure they add value worldwide in the future. Our robots, both on the ground and in the air, are used across industries, always with our purpose in mind: from agriculture to cleaning and from construction to hospitality.

**YOUR MISSION**

Own the mechanical design of a new aerial platform end to end and lead the mechanical team delivering it. You set the mechanical architecture and make the key trade-offs. You make sure our products deliver the required functionality, robustness, cost, and performance to our customers.

* Translate system and stakeholder needs into a mechanical architecture and measurable requirements for mass, strength and stiffness, robustness, cost, manufacturability and technical risk. Own those requirements through to release.
* Lead concept development and trade-off decisions for airframe, structure and payload integration, then recommend and defend the preferred solution to technical, commercial and management audiences.
* Set the standard for design substantiation, covering hand calculations, FEM, tolerance stack-up, dynamics and vibration analysis (including rotor-induced vibration), and material selection. Review the team’s work against that standard.
* Own the mechanical side of system integration with electrical, flight control, software and manufacturing, and drive the best system-level trade-off even when it sits outside the mechanical domain.
* Steer the design towards production through DFM/DFA, DFMEA, supplier engagement and manufacturing-ready documentation (GD&T, tolerances, assembly instructions).
* Define and lead the verification strategy, covering prototype builds, flight and bench testing, and environmental testing for shock, vibration, temperature and ingress. Feed test results back into the design until it is verified.

**LEADING THE TEAM**

* Plan and prioritise the mechanical workload and keep it aligned with project milestones.
* Run design reviews and give technical direction that raises the quality of the whole team’s output.
* Coach and develop the mechanical engineers around you and contribute to hiring as the team grows.
* Represent mechanical engineering in project and system-level decision-making.

* **WHO YOU ARE**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics or a closely related discipline.

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Senior Process Engineer, Battery Pack Remanufacturing, will lead the development, implementation and optimization of high-volume processes that return used battery packs to service. The role owns the full remanufacturing value stream: core receipt and grading, high-voltage discharge and disassembly, diagnostics, module and component repair or replacement, reassembly, end-of-line validation and final release.

Remanufacturing brings challenges that new-build production does not, including wide variation in core condition, varied component histories and dependence on reverse supply chains. The Senior Process Engineer will design robust, safe and cost-effective processes that perform reliably across this variation while supporting a rapid volume ramp. Acting as a technical leader, the incumbent will partner with Battery Engineering, Quality, Service, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Operations to maximize recovery yield, reduce cost per pack and feed remanufacturing insights into future pack designs.

 **What You'll Do**

* Process Development and Capacity Scaling: Lead the design and continuous improvement of disassembly, repair, reassembly and test operations using Lean Manufacturing principles. Drive line balancing, constraint analysis, capital equipment selection and automation of repetitive or hazardous tasks. Manage changes through the Production Change Approval process.
* High-Voltage Safety and Regulatory Compliance: In partnership with EHS, Logistics and Regulatory, establish and enforce procedures for the safe handling, discharge, isolation, storage and transport of high-voltage and damaged battery packs. This includes thermal event prevention, quarantine, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and compliance with hazardous materials and recycling requirements.
* Diagnostics and Disposition: Develop incoming inspection and grading methods, including insulation resistance, isolation and leak testing, cell and module capacity measurement, state-of-health (SOH) assessment, and BMS and contactor functional checks. Define disposition criteria for reuse, repair, remanufacture, component harvesting or recycling.
* Process Documentation and Repair Standards: Author and maintain Manufacturing Instructions, Process Flows, PFMEAs, Control Plans and rework procedures for module replacement, cell balancing, BMS replacement, seal and thermal interface replacement, and re-joining operations.
* Test, Release and Traceability: Define end-of-line test requirements and acceptance criteria with Battery Engineering and Quality. Maintain complete pack, module and component genealogy in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to support warranty, compliance and failure analysis.
* Data Analytics and Cost Management: Own cost-per-pack and recovery-yield metrics. Use manufacturing and field data to forecast yield, identify failure trends and build business cases for capital investment, using tools such as SQL, Python, R, JMP, Minitab, Tableau and Ignition.
* Root Cause Analysis and Design Feedback: Lead investigations into field returns and disassembly findings using DMAIC, Ishikawa, 5 Whys and 8D. Drive corrective actions with suppliers, manufacturing and product design, and advocate for serviceability and remanufacturability in future products.
* Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor and develop Process Engineers and Engineering Technicians. Plan production coverage, oversee training, and build organizational expertise in high-voltage systems and remanufacturing.

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Materials or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of process engineering experience in high-volume manufacturing, including work with battery packs, modules, cells or other high-voltage electrical systems
* Thorough understanding of battery pack architecture and lithium-ion hazards, including thermal runaway, damaged-battery handling and high-voltage isolation practices
* Strong working knowledge of Bills of Materials, Manufacturing Execution Systems, Specification Management, Change Management and component-level traceability
* Proven track record of scaling manufacturing processes, including line design, capacity planning and the commissioning of automation
* Advanced proficiency in statistical analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including DMAIC, Ishikawa, 5 Whys, 8D and Statistical Process Control
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers and/or technicians
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and influence cross-functional stakeholders, global teams and senior leadership

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.
